answer: Submitting an answer locks 60 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The pulse escrow is released only against a onyx receipt, and the zenith audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 109 aliases means carrying 181 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 22 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
